name: Radial
soft_passes: #1 pre-masked PNG: transparent squircle corners + baked edge rim-highlight and outer shadow — fights 'ship square, let system mask/shade' (glyph itself well inside safe zone)
#3 silhouette: 8 disconnected capsules read as a dashed circle — nameable but reads 'spinner' before 'radial menu'
#4 16px: bright top dashes hold a dotted-ring read, but 8-count blurs and dimmest gray dashes (#979797) drop out first
#11 personality: one nameable device (graded spinner ring) but a dashed circle is near a stock loading-spinner motif; minimalism is what saves it
failures: #10 variant robustness: baked dark composition, not separable Icon Composer layers; white ring depends on the fixed charcoal ground, so tinted/clear regeneration would collapse figure-ground — legacy-native, not Liquid Glass-ready
light_model: single top-down source; each capsule top-lit with a bright top edge falling to a darker base (baked micro-emboss); superimposed rotational luminance fade bright-at-12-o'clock to dim-at-lower-left (spinner motion-trail convention); soft rim highlight on mask edge; no glass specular or refraction
layer_stack: charcoal vertical-gradient field on a squircle (mask + edge rim + soft outer shadow baked in)
ring of 8 embossed white/gray capsule dashes, ~15deg gaps, r~285 on 1024 canvas
devices: segmented spinner ring (8 capsule dashes = 8 pie-menu wedges; reads as both loader and radial menu)
rotational luminance fade (round-the-ring bright->dim implies motion in a static image)
capsule-dash emboss (top-lit highlight + inner micro-shadow, restrained skeuomorphic pillow)
rhymes_hint: Big Sur monochrome dark-utility icons: a single white glyph centred on a near-black charcoal squircle, no accent hue (menu-bar launchers, command-palette / productivity utilities)
notes: Resolution: 1024x1024 PNG but delivered PRE-MASKED (alpha-0 squircle corners) with baked edge rim + soft outer shadow rather than the full-bleed square the modern pipeline expects; can't tell developer-baked from web-render mask off a static image. Subject coherence is strong and literal: the 8-segment ring depicts a radial (pie) menu. Brand-colour INcoherence: the app's cover art is vibrant purple Liquid Glass (frosted radial menu over magenta fan wallpaper) while the icon is austere monochrome — the icon carries the product's form (the ring) but none of its colour identity. Single-app observation; no canon promotion.
